correctness.rationale: Exact algebraic-integer arithmetic reconstructs all 49 lines from twelve dodecagon sides (66 seed points, 913 pair-joining candidates). All 18424 triple determinants are enumerated: 1120 zero, 60 nonzero norm values with combined prime support {2,3,11,13}. Coordinate-norm gcd tests establish that all 49 lines remain defined and mutually distinct in p>=5. Both square roots of 3 in F11 and F13 give respective full collision profiles. The standalone verifier was actually executed successfully; line-pair weighted sums equal 1176 in all cases. The infinite-prime step follows rigorously from the determinant norm criterion, not sampling.

value.rationale: The bad-reduction locus of the entire incidence matroid of a rigid 49-line free arrangement is a natural complete arithmetic invariant. The precise profiles distinguish two exceptional degenerations with no line components merging. This supplies the complete boundary of combinatorial stability and is not inferable from the complex intersection table; it has direct use in studying combinatorial preservation in positive characteristic.
